current.text: He is a projected starter at forward, next to Brunson, Bridges, Hart and Towns.
He is the third option behind Brunson and Towns. His usage was just under 20 percent in about 33 minutes per game.
Expect more big scoring nights when Brunson or Towns rest. He is not projected to average 25 points.
The Knicks won the title. He was their next best player for stretches of the Finals and attacked Wembanyama directly with success.
Experts expect the Knicks to be careful with his minutes after the long title run, so his minutes could drop.

The Knicks are expected to trim starters' minutes and give more rest on back-to-backs over the first 30 or so games. The newest team note says a weaker team in a stronger East may not be able to rest players as much.
Some experts worry about a championship hangover: a minute or two less, a small rise in injury risk and some regression.
He has one of the widest outcome ranges in his tier, from about 22nd to 89th, mostly because his steals vary. The expert still feels confident in him.

Experts see value at his rank of about 69 to 72 in category leagues. One calls Yahoo rank 69 fantastic value and ESPN ADP 85 a steal, another calls pick 72 way too late. One expert calls rank 69 only OK for categories.
In a mock auction he was expected near 20 USD and went for 16 USD, which the expert still called good value.
The Knicks play a league-minimum 13 back-to-backs. Their fantasy playoff schedule is weak for a season that ends March 28.
The Knicks are projected to win about 50 to 54 games.

durable.text: He is worth much more in category leagues than in points leagues.
Steals are his best category, well above the top 250 pool. He also gives good threes for a forward.
He can be streaky, with hot stretches followed by weeks of inconsistency.
He has had knee and ankle problems over his career but has stayed healthy for two seasons with the Knicks. Experts still flag injury risk.

note: Anunoby is a no-weakness category forward. His steals (z +1.6) and threes (2.3 per game) carry his value, so he fits any build. Yahoo values him at 16 USD, he went for 15 USD in our league last season and 16 USD in an expert mock auction, and experts think he is worth about 20 USD in category leagues. Check his minutes over the first 30 or so games, since the Knicks may trim them. The Knicks' playoff schedule is weak for our March 28 end, so he is a possible trade chip before the deadline.
